Hello,

Your car, the Bentley Continental GT, is on the road in Germany near Münster. The driver, Leo Quellford, picked it up from Cologne this morning at 09:00 local time and is heading north toward the ferry.

The ferry is booked for tonight, Wednesday 21 October, departing at 19:30 from the West Baltic Vehicle Terminal. Check-in closes at 17:30. After the crossing, the car will continue toward Helsinki.

The driver's app currently gives a coarse delivery estimate of Monday 26 October around 14:50 Finnish time. This estimate is from nearly 2,000 km away and will refine as the journey progresses. At this stage it suggests the car should arrive during the promised delivery window (Monday 10:00–16:00), though close to the 14:00 time you mentioned for your buyer.

We will have a clearer picture after the ferry crossing and as the car gets closer. I will update you once the ferry has been boarded and the estimate tightens.

If you have any questions in the meantime, please let me know.

Best regards
